name: Reproducible build, configuration, and provenance capture
purpose: Make every linked M0 result attributable and reproducible.
production_capability: Configured Moon executable and its complete build/run identity.
configuration: One MPI rank, one OpenMP thread; neutral-Na SPICE baseline unless a test declares its frozen alternate fixture.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Rank/thread layout and random seed are mandatory manifest fields.
procedure: Hash inputs/executable/data and record command, source state, configuration, species, seed, and layout.
acceptance_criteria: Every required field and referenced file hash exists; no unhashed external file is accepted.
required_data: configured SPICE kernels for SPICE runs
status_semantics: PASS is provenance capture only; a missing required file is ERROR and does not validate physics.
